scripts.build: bun build mods/{{name}}/main.ts --outfile mods/{{name}}/main.js --external gpui-kit --external gpui --external gpui-base --external gpui-component --external gpui-shell --external gpui-fps --external buffer --external path --external url --external crypto --external zlib --external console --external process --external os --external fs/promises --external net --external websocket --external herdr
scripts.mod:install: pnpm run build && dest="${HERDR_APP_HOME:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/herdr-app}/mods/{{name}}" && mkdir -p "$dest" && cp mods/{{name}}/main.js mods/{{name}}/mod.json "$dest"
scripts.check:layer:herdr: pnpm run build && herdr-app check mods/{{name}}
